behavior: Shy but vocal; forages in foliage and on the forest floor with short or springy hops, gleaning arthropods and sometimes lunging, hovering, or flycatching. Also eats fruit, especially during migration and the nonbreeding season, and migrates mainly at night.
field_marks: Prominent buff eye-ring extending toward the bill to form a spectacled face pattern
Whitish underparts with brown spotting concentrated on the throat and breast
Round head with a short, straight, dark bill
Fairly long, pointed wings and a medium-length tail
habitat: Primarily closed-canopy coniferous, mixed, or deciduous forest with a shaded, dense understory; also uses streamside thickets and young woodland. During migration it occupies varied wooded habitats with dense cover, while nonbreeding habitat includes tropical forest and forest edges.
